scope: Independent CPU-only validation of completed case metadata, time pairing, actuator telemetry, proxy rewind, and geometry; not force-accuracy certification
interpretation: Passing checks establish recorded-state, units, time-alignment and calculation integrity; they do not establish accurate force prediction or stable robot control.
source_checks: Newton lagged proxy coupling copies old foot pose and post-articulation velocity, then removes previous feedback using proxy inertia; the recorder captures after this rewind.
Foot centers of mass use model.body_com transformed by body pose; shape corners use the independent collision-shape transform.
Native MuJoCo actuator forces are logged separately from Newton feed-forward joint force; they are not estimator target inputs.
Matched-input estimators read the same pre-MPM proxy/particle positions and post-MPM particle velocities. Captured proxy arrays are checked exactly; per-step particle velocities are not stored.
Policy inputs are proprioceptive history and command; foot-contact observations belong to the privileged critic group.
Root state combines world root-link pose (XYZW quaternion) and world center-of-mass velocity; report velocity uses inverse quaternion rotation into root-link axes.

analytic_contract_test.execution: Separate recorded test run; not executed by this validation script
analytic_contract_test.scope: GPU single-contact analytic impulse with rotated offset collision shape and nonzero COM offset, followed by separated-contact reset

checks: requested material parameters and total mass
four physics intervals per policy step
native actuator force present and nonzero
left/right foot identity and actual collision geometry
ground clearance and separate rigid-ground force telemetry when available
matched-input estimator parameters and proxy states
